Apple's New MacBook Air 15 launched 15.3-inch display, M2 chip, Six-speaker
Apple has launched its new MacBook Air 15-inch model based on the M2 chip in India at its WWDC 2023event. It has a large 15.3-inch Liquid Retina display with 500 nits of brightness, and has the same fanless design, as the 13-inch model, but this has an all-new six-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio and up to 18 hours of battery life.
The thickness of the MacBook Air is just 11.5 mm and weighs just 1.4 kg. There is a 1080p Facetime HD camera inside a notch and has an all-aluminum unibody enclosure and integrates its components so efficiently. It also has MagSafe charging port, two Thunderbolt ports for connecting accessories, up to a 6K external display, and a 3.5mm headphone jack.
